en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us: Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us: Jarir ibn Hazim informed us: Muhammad ibn Sirin narrated to us, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: 'None spoke in the cradle except three: Jesus son of Mary, and the companion of Jurayj. Jurayj was a devoted worshipper who built a hermitage and stayed in it. His mother came to him while he was praying and called: "O Jurayj!" He said: "O Lord, my mother or my prayer?" So he continued with his prayer, and she departed. On the following day she came to him while he was praying and called: "O Jurayj!" He said: "O Lord, my mother or my prayer?" So he continued with his prayer, and she departed. On the following day she came to him while he was praying and called: "O Jurayj!" He said: "O Lord, my mother or my prayer?" So he continued with his prayer. Thereupon she said: "O Allah, do not let him die until he looks at the faces of prostitutes." The Children of Israel mentioned Jurayj and his devotion. There was a prostitute whose beauty was proverbially praised, and she said: "If you wish, I will seduce him for you." He said: So she offered herself to him, but he paid no attention to her. She then went to a shepherd who used to take shelter near his hermitage and gave herself to him, so he had intercourse with her and she became pregnant. When she gave birth, she said: "It is from Jurayj." So they came to him, brought him down, demolished his hermitage, and began beating him. He asked: "What is the matter with you?" They said: "You committed fornication with this prostitute and she bore a child from you." He said: "Where is the child?" They brought him, and he said: "Leave me until I pray." So he prayed. When he finished, he went to the child, poked him in his belly, and said: "O boy, who is your father?" He said: "So-and-so, the shepherd." He said: Thereupon they turned to Jurayj, kissing him, touching him to seek blessing, and said: "We will rebuild your hermitage of gold." He said: "No, rebuild it of clay as it was." So they did so. And while a child was suckling from his mother, a man rode by on a magnificent mount and fine attire. His mother said: "O Allah, make my son like this man." Thereupon the baby left the breast, turned toward him, looked at him, and said: "O Allah, do not make me like him." Then he returned to her breast and began suckling.' He [Abu Hurayrah] said: 'It is as if I am looking at the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) imitating his suckling with his forefinger in his mouth, sucking it.' He said: 'Then they passed by a slave-girl whom they were beating, saying: "You committed fornication! You stole!" while she was saying: "Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs." His mother said: "O Allah, do not make my son like her." So he left suckling, looked at her, and said: "O Allah, make me like her." Thereupon they exchanged words, and she said: "Woe to you! A fine-looking man passed by and I said, 'O Allah, make my son like him,' but you said, 'O Allah, do not make me like him.' Then they passed by this slave-girl while beating her and saying, 'You committed fornication, you stole,' so I said, 'O Allah, do not make my son like her,' but you said, 'O Allah, make me like her.'" He said: "Indeed, that man was a tyrant, so I said, 'O Allah, do not make me like him.' And as for this girl, they say to her, 'You committed fornication,' yet she did not commit fornication, and 'You stole,' yet she did not steal, so I said, 'O Allah, make me like her.'"'
